mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To contribute to the growth of the Sultanate of Oman and to improve people's lives by providing reliable Power & Water, while being committed to employee development and empowerment.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: The most reliable, innovative and flexible company in the Power and Water sector with advanced Health, Safety and Environment (H&SE) practices and respectful work environment, developing new business opportunities and Omani leaders while promoting social responsibility initiatives.
